title: When You Feel Worn Out
hook: If today feels heavier than you can carry, this prayer is for you.

bible_verse.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verification.note: Verse quoted from memory (KJV, public domain in the US). Check it against a reliable KJV edition before setting status to 'verified'.

prayer: Father, you know what I am facing right now, even the parts I have not said out loud. I am tired, and some days I do not know how to keep going.
Be my strength where mine has run out. When fear speaks louder than faith, remind me I am not alone. Give me light for the next step, even if I cannot see the whole road.
Hold the ones I love who are hurting too. And when this season passes, let me look back and see your hand in every hard day. Amen.
closing: Breathe slowly. You do not have to carry it all today.
tiktok_description: For the days when everything feels like too much. You are not alone. 🤍
